# Elide components

> A production example of Elide's React component library and design tokens.

This page demonstrates buttons, tabs, dialogs, switches, accordion panels, and
cards. It has no account, payment, or remote mutation features. Theme changes
are local. Copy controls write the displayed command to the user's clipboard.

## Resources

- [Component examples](/): Interactive examples with server-rendered content.
- [Source and documentation](https://github.com/elide-dev/components): Component APIs, tokens, and integration guidance.

- [Internationalization examples](/i18n.html): Prerendered Hebrew UI with optional locale loading, RTL navigation and isolated code.
